div.head: Had. 2 [as Að]
div.ab: Be gehadodra manna aðe; 7 be hadbote. Mæssepreostes að 7 worldþegnes is on Engla lage geteald efen dire for ðam seofon cirichadan, þe se preost þurh Godes gife geþéah, þæt he hæfde.

Concerning the oath of ecclesiastics and concerning the compensation for offences against [those in] holy orders. The oath of a mass-priest and a secular thegn is in the law of the English reckoned equally valuable, because of the seven orders of the Church which the priest, prospering through the grace of God, has obtained.
Mæssepreostes að 7 woruldþegenes is on Engla lage geteald efen dyre; 7 for þam seofon cyrichadan, þe se mæssepreost þurh Godes gife geþeah, þat he hæfde, he bið þegenrihtes wyrþe.
A mass-priest's oath and a secular thegn's are considered equal in English law because of the seven Church degrees that the mass-priest has acquired through the grace of God
